name: Sentimental Memorial
original_name: センチメンタル・メモリアル
source:
A groundbreaking idea to play Tokimeki Memorial with Sentimental Graffiti characters.

Main character is a senior high school student. He will spend this year in the company of six beautiful girls.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-december-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
本作的創意頗為大膽：讓《青澀寶貝》的角色登場，體驗《純愛手札》式的玩法。

主角是一名高中生，將在六位美麗女孩的陪伴下度過這一年。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-december-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
